summary: Repair the root cause in the strict-test failure terminal/audit contract: it is currently stage-blind. Define a deterministic stage-to-authority matrix for every STRICT_TEST_FAILED stage. Early preflight failures must be creatable, validatable, and reportable using only authority that exists at that moment, without requiring later confirmation/projection or a successfully completed preflight receipt when it cannot yet exist. Stages after confirmation/projection must require their exact non-null predecessor hashes and matching contexts; reject null, mismatched, missing, or temporally post-failure substitute receipts. Make failure audit/report composition stage-aware instead of forcing the successful completion context shape. Preserve the five repaired completion tamper gates, exact 26-state/full-lineage validators, strict-production/legacy testMode hashes, public entrypoints, and Core-only boundary. Add controller-equivalent causal regression probes plus full validation.
designIntent: Preserve the repaired completion validators and strict-production behavior, and make STRICT_TEST_FAILED receipts/audits causally stage-aware: bind exactly the predecessor authorities that existed at the failure stage, never successful future receipts or missing already-required lineage.

required.verify: A new AlembicCore-owned commit after 933920fa214c1ba04787244f073145bcc48e929c contains only the assigned strict-test failure authority/validator/test work.

Focused tests prove pre-confirmation failure validation/reporting without future contexts, post-projection failure rejection when confirmation/projection lineage is null/missing/mismatched, causal timestamp ordering, and preservation of the five prior semantic-forgery regressions; full Core tests pass.
AlembicCore build/type/public API/boundary/layer/consumer import/lint checks pass.

Reviewable source defines and enforces an explicit stage-to-required-authority matrix for failure creation, validation, and audit/report composition, including preflight-stage authority without manufacturing successful confirmation/projection receipts.

Executable controller-equivalent probes reject post-failure/future substitute contexts and late-stage null predecessor hashes while accepting a causally valid early-stage failure with only then-existing authority.

targetTasks.summary: Implement and prove stage-aware STRICT_TEST_FAILED causal authority and audit semantics; preserve all prior completion validator fixes and strict-production.
